name: EVE The Lost One
source:
"Eve: The Lost One" is a direct sequel to  Eve Burst Error.
The game tells what happened in Eldia after the young queen became the ruler of the country.

The player takes the roles of the female detective called Kyoko, and the mysterious Snake, as they try to solve a complex mystery full of betrayals and political intrigues.

Kyoko is the more standard protagonist, an agent who investigates a murder case. She is much more talkative; she makes much more comments, meets more people, her thinking is less enigmatic, her motives clear.
On the other hand Snake is much more mysterious. It's not possible to know know his true identity, his goal is unknown, and it's impossible to tell whose side he is on.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/eve-the-lost-one]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《EVE The Lost One》是《EVE Burst Error》的直接续作，讲述年轻女王统治埃尔迪亚之后发生的故事。

玩家分别扮演女侦探恭子与神秘人物Snake，设法破解一场充满背叛与政治阴谋的复杂谜案。

恭子属于较为传统的主人公，是一名调查谋杀案的特工。她话更多，也会发表更多评论、接触更多人物，思维不那么难以捉摸，动机也十分明确。
相比之下，Snake则神秘得多。他的真实身份、目的和立场都无从判断。

[编辑自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/eve-the-lost-one]MobyGames[/url]]
